surface_name: Notion API markdown update and notion-update-page
title: Notion page markdown edit returns 400 validation_error on a very large page and retrying never works
symptoms: HTTP 400 validation_error when updating page content as markdown
tags appear when the page is retrieved as markdown
Same request used to return 500 internal_server_error and keeps failing on retry
cause: Since October 2, 2026, a page with about 20,000 records (mostly blocks) is not loaded in full. An edit that targets a block that was not loaded, or would remove content that was not loaded, is rejected. Earlier the same case returned a 500, so retry logic written for 500 now loops on a permanent failure.
fix: Do not retry this 400. Retrieve the page as markdown and edit only content outside the  tags, or split the page into smaller pages. Read additional_data.limit for the cap.
apply: On 400 validation_error where additional_data.limit_kind == "page_record_count": stop retrying and limit edits to content outside <unknown> tags
affected: Update a page's content as markdown and the notion-update-page MCP tool, from 2026-10-02
